# Dora

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is a neat and proper character with gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a "prunes and prisms" mouth. She wears her hair in long, sleek curls that never get out of order. Her attire includes a nicely starched white dress accented by a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a lovely, demure, and exceptionally well-behaved child who comports herself as a model of good conduct. She is quiet, neat, faithful, and observant, rarely speaking unless spoken to and never needing to be told how to perform her duties twice. Characterized as industrious, careful, systematic, and dispassionate, she takes pleasure in helping with small tasks and attends to her duties with methodical care. Though some view her as so prim, proper, and composed that her behavior seems monotonous, she remains consistently good, motionless in quiet moments, and rarely causes any trouble.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), +9 more_

## History

Dora Keith arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her twin brother, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), after being brought there by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) following their mother's funeral. Soon after her arrival, she was tricked by her brother into falling into a pigpen, and later went missing when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) locked her in a toolhouse and lied about it. During [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's time as a teacher, Dora was comforted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after being frightened by ghost stories at school. Her living situation at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) became permanent after her uncle passed away and left money in trust for her and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), +298 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora and [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) are twin brother and sister who come to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following their mother's funeral. Their relationship is characterized by Davy's mischievous pranks aimed at Dora, such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen and later locking her in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. Despite his tendency to target her with his antics and lies, the two continue to share daily life and outings together under the care of [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +8 more</sub>
